reason: The image-only reading left the places and sealer uncertain ('Welthau?', 'Natzers?/Natters?', 'Sonnenburg?'); the reread on native crops reads Wilten (Welthau) as sealer, Natters and the Landgericht Sonnenburg, and shows the year clause unfinished at 'Achtund'.

No outside text of the act exists. The left ends of all lines are physically lost at the cut edge ([...]). Expansions in parentheses, uncertain readings (?). Lines L7-L8 surnames and the feast word revised after a blind word check: initial K or A uncertain; feast read 'Pauls bekerr[ung]' by the coordinator, 'Peiers Ackerer?' by the fresh reader.
